fact: FrontPage Africa reports that a Central Bank of Liberia employee invented a banking system, the 'First Sovereign AI Infrastructure for Predicting Macroeconomic Forecasting and Financial Intelligence in the Region', which the bank is currently using.
system: First Sovereign AI Infrastructure for Predicting Macroeconomic Forecasting and Financial Intelligence in the Region

fact: The Central Bank of Liberia's governor said the bank is at an early stage of AI adoption and moving from experimentation to a more structured approach.

The Liberia Revenue Authority says in its own post that it is developing an AI-powered Contact Center, with the Kwagei Group, to give taxpayers tax and customs information, and that a working retreat prepared the tax and customs knowledge base for it.
